help.title: 🎮 American Tile Trails - Complete Guide
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know to play American Tile Trails

overview.title: 🌟 Overview
overview.description: American Tile Trails is a tile-placement strategy game inspired by Carcassonne, set in the American landscape. Players take turns placing tiles to build roads, Costco shopping areas, and McDonald's restaurants while claiming features with followers to score points.

objective.title: 🎯 Objective
objective.description: Score the most points by strategically placing tiles and claiming completed features with your followers.

gameSetup.title: 🎲 Game Setup
gameSetup.numberOfPlayersDesc: 2-5 players (mix of human and AI players)
gameSetup.playerSetupDesc: Enter player names, choose colors, select human or AI
gameSetup.firstTileDesc: A random starting tile is placed at the center of the board
gameSetup.shuffledDeckDesc: Remaining 40 tiles form a shuffled deck for gameplay

gameplay.title: 🎮 Gameplay
gameplay.drawTileDesc: You automatically receive a random tile from the deck
gameplay.rotateTileDesc: Click "Rotate Tile" button to change orientation
gameplay.placeTileDesc: Click on a valid (green highlighted) position on the board
gameplay.claimingDesc: After placing a tile, you may claim ONE feature on that tile
gameplay.mcdonaldsDesc: Claim the restaurant (1 point per tile in the 3x3 area, max 9)
gameplay.followerLimitDesc: You can only claim if you have followers available
gameplay.skipOptionDesc: You can choose not to claim any feature
gameplay.farmerClaimingDesc: Claim a field area - farmer stays until game end and scores for adjacent completed Costcos
gameplay.immediateScoringDesc: When features are completed, points are awarded instantly
gameplay.followerReturnDesc: Followers on completed features return to your supply

controls.title: 🎮 Controls & Interface
controls.zoomDesc: Scroll or pinch to zoom. Fit board restores automatic framing.
controls.panDesc: Drag to move around the board
controls.tilePlacementDesc: Click a green space to place. On touchscreens, tap to preview, then confirm.
controls.currentTileDisplayDesc: Shows the tile you need to place with rotation controls
controls.scoreboardDesc: Live player scores, followers, and turn indicator
controls.activityLogDesc: Real-time feed of game events and player actions
controls.newGameButtonDesc: Reset and start a fresh game

roads.title: Roads (1 point per tile)
roads.completionDesc: Road segments connect from one end to another or form loops
roads.scoringDesc: 1 point per tile in the completed road
roads.strategyDesc: Quick to complete but lower point value

costco.title: Costco Shopping Areas (2 points per tile)
costco.completionDesc: Costco areas are completely surrounded by roads or board edges
costco.scoringDesc: 2 points per tile in the completed Costco area
costco.strategyDesc: Higher point value but harder to complete than roads

mcdonalds.title: McDonald's Restaurants (1 point per tile)
mcdonalds.completionDesc: Complete when all 8 surrounding positions have tiles
mcdonalds.riskRewardDesc: Difficult to complete but worth many points (max 9)

farmers.title: Farmers (3 points per adjacent Costco)
farmers.placementDesc: Farmers are placed lying down on field areas (grass between roads and Costcos)
farmers.permanentDesc: Unlike other followers, farmers STAY on the board until game end
farmers.scoringDesc: At game end, score 3 points per completed Costco touching the field
farmers.strategyDesc: High-risk, high-reward - commit a follower permanently for potential big end-game points

gameEndScoring.title: Game End Scoring
gameEndScoring.incompleteFeaturesDesc: Roads 1 per tile, Costcos 1 per tile + 1 per pennant, McDonald's 1 per tile in the 3x3 area
gameEndScoring.majorityRuleDesc: When multiple players have followers on the same feature, only the player(s) with the MOST followers score points. Ties: all tied players get full points.
gameEndScoring.winnerDesc: Player with the most total points wins

ai.title: 🤖 AI Players
ai.delay: AI players make moves with a 1-second delay
ai.strategy: AI considers feature completion opportunities, tile adjacency, Costco preferences, and follower conservation
ai.indicator: AI players are marked with 🤖 in the scoreboard

difficultyDesc.easy: Easy: Random moves with occasional claims - good for beginners
difficultyDesc.medium: Medium: Weighted heuristics for balanced, competitive play
difficultyDesc.hard: Hard: Strategic play with look-ahead and defensive moves
difficultyDesc.expert: Expert: Advanced strategy with deep analysis and blocking

strategy.title: 💡 Strategy Tips
strategy.balanceClaimingExpansionDesc: Don't claim every feature - save followers for high-value opportunities
strategy.blockOpponentsDesc: Place tiles to make opponent features harder to complete
strategy.multipleFeaturesDesc: Look for tiles that contribute to multiple features simultaneously
strategy.followerConservationDesc: Manage your 7 followers carefully - you can't get more during the game
strategy.costcoStrategyDesc: Costcos are worth 2x points but require more planning to complete
strategy.mcdonaldsRiskDesc: Max 9 points is tempting, but McDonald's are very hard to complete safely

winning.title: 🎯 Winning Conditions
winning.gameEndDesc: Game ends when no more tiles remain in the deck
winning.finalScoringDesc: Incomplete features score by type (roads 1 per tile, Costcos 1 per tile + 1 per pennant, McDonald's 1 per tile in the 3x3 area)
winning.winnerDesc: Player with highest total score wins (tied players share victory)

gettingStarted.title: 🚀 Getting Started
gettingStarted.configurePlayersDesc: Set up 2-5 players with names and types
gettingStarted.startPlayingDesc: Begin placing tiles and claiming features
gettingStarted.learnByPlayingDesc: The interface guides you through each phase

finalNote.title: 🗺️ Have fun building your American landscape!
finalNote.description: The game combines strategic thinking with tactical tile placement for an engaging multiplayer experience. Each game creates a unique map of roads, shopping centers, and restaurants across the American countryside.
